# Long-horizon feature ablation: single test evaluation (generated by `scripts/run_long_ablation.py`)

Git commit `d24c7c01f5`. XGBoost, ratio target, long-horizon hyper-parameters, 3 seeds, MAE in MW. Trees fixed from validation; models fitted on the training period only. Differences are second set minus first set (negative = the added group helps), 95% block bootstrap.

## Horizon 72 h

| feature set | MAE (MW) |
|---|---:|
| S0_history | 6,512 |
| S1_calendar | 6,089 |
| S2_holidays | 6,016 |
| S3_weatherA | 5,969 |
| S4_full_A | 6,018 |
| S5_oracle_B (oracle weather) | 5,321 |

| step | MAE difference (95% CI) |
|---|---|
| calendar (S0 -> S1) | -423 (-652 to -156) |
| holidays (S1 -> S2) | -73 (-337 to +139) |
| past weather (S2 -> S3) | -47 (-151 to +63) |
| past solar and wind (S3 -> S4) | +50 (-107 to +186) |
| ORACLE weather (S4 -> S5) | -697 (-1,026 to -413) |
